simple.meaning: נִשְׁכָּה (nishkâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a cell.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H5393. nishkah נִשְׁכָּה noun feminine chamber (rare || of לִשְׁכָּה , q. v.; compare W SG 67 ); — absolute ׳נ Neh 13:7 , suffix נִשְׁכָּתוֺ 3:30 , both rooms of individuals; plural absolute נְשָׁכוֺת 12:44 (Chronicles) = treasuries, storehouses.

occurrences.englishText: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

On that day, men were appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them, according to the fields of the cities, the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who waited.
and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.
